result.promptEn: The supplied reference image is the single visual authority for this product, showing a gray dish with a white label. Maintain the dish's gray color, overall shape, and the distinct white label exactly as shown. Any changes to the shape, colors, or the label are prohibited. The commercial will be a clean studio-style video for Instagram, 8 seconds long, vertical aspect ratio (9:16), divided into three shots. Start with a close-up push-in shot highlighting the white label and smooth gray surface of the dish, emphasizing the contrast and clarity. Next, a stable front shot showing the full silhouette and proportions of the dish, presenting its simple and functional design. Finally, a slow lateral tracking shot smoothly circles around the dish to showcase the label and the material finish, ensuring the color and texture appear natural and consistent. Lighting is even and soft, revealing the matte or smooth texture of the dish without shadows or glare, on a clean neutral background that enhances product visibility. The product remains static or is lightly rotated realistically, no added effects or movements that would alter its shape or materials. Audio is subtle room tone with soft product handling sounds if any handling is shown. The final shot ends with a clear, stable frame of the dish facing forward, highlighting the white label. Render quality aims for clear texture detail and crisp color fidelity without artifacts. Fidelity must preserve the dish’s exact form, gray tone, and visible white label in all shots. Avoid adding text overlays, invented branding, or environmental distractions that detract from the product’s simplicity and presentation.
assumptionsUz: Idish materiali nomaʻlum, lekin yuzasi silliq yoki mat koʻrinadi deb taxmin qilinadi
Idish kattaligi va hajmi haqida maʻlumot yoʻq, shuning uchun oʻrtacha idish oʻlchamida tasvirlanadi
reviewNotesUz: Mahsulot juda soddaligi sababli, eʻtibor yorliq va rang kontrasti mavjudligiga qaratiladi
Koʻproq maʻlumot yoki boshqa burchaklardan koʻrinish taqdim etilsa, reklama yanada aniqroq boʻladi
